As of 18:30 UTC today, it appears that MoombaBlasta's account has been terminated. It was most likely shut down sometime between 1600 and 1830.

MoombaBlasta ([YouTube Page Archive](https://web.archive.org/web/20160310002542/https://www.youtube.com/user/MoombaBlasta)) was a YouTube channel that promoted moombahton music. According to their [Twitter page](https://twitter.com/moombablasta), they began operating in 2011. Their most popular video was Diplo - Boy Oh Boy, which according to the [Wayback machine](https://web.archive.org/web/20160511074123/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5nT0g887ShE&index=25&list=RDTPcOdaPNQXU) had over 70 million views on May 11.

As of a few hours ago, I could load their videos with no issues. Now, all the videos are down and it says the account was terminated. If you go to the [channel webpage](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkDFhY_lf41Iyxe9quc0heg), it says "MoombaBlasta has been terminated because we received multiple third-party claims of copyright infringement regarding material the user posted." Furthermore, it appears that their videos have also been removed from search results. I wonder whether they will come back, or if this is permanent.
